## Features

| feature | bit | policy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MAC | 5 | accepted when offered; needs device window >= 6 bytes |
| VERSION_1 | 32 | required, else NO_VERSION_1 |
| ACCESS_PLATFORM | 33 | accepted when offered; required with flag REQUIRE_ACCESS_PLATFORM, else NO_ACCESS_PLATFORM |

Every other feature bit is declined.

## Bring-up

1. write STATUS = 0x0
2. poll STATUS until 0 (at most RESET_POLLS reads), else RESET_TIMEOUT
3. write STATUS = ACK
4. write STATUS = ACK|DRIVER
5. from here a failure marks the device FAILED
6. negotiate features (table above)
7. write STATUS = ACK|DRIVER|FEATURES_OK
8. check STATUS Has(["FEATURES_OK"], []), else FEATURES
9. accepted features become active
10. write MSIX = 0xffff
11. check NUMQ Ge(2), else QUEUES
12. set up rings RX, TX (qsetup below)
13. read MAC while CFGGEN holds still (at most CFGGEN_TRIES tries), else CONFIG, only when MAC is accepted
14. post every RX buffer
15. write STATUS = ACK|DRIVER|FEATURES_OK|DRIVER_OK
16. check STATUS Has(["DRIVER_OK"], ["NEEDS_RESET", "FAILED"]), else DEVICE
17. device is live
18. ring the RX doorbell

Per ring (qsetup):

1. write Q_SELECT = ring
2. read Q_SIZE as max
3. check max Ne(0), else QUEUES
4. check Q_ENABLE Eq(0), else QUEUES
5. halve the wanted size until it fits max; below QUEUE_MIN: QUEUES
6. write Q_SIZE = size
7. write Q_MSIX = 0xffff
8. doorbell offset = Q_NOFF x multiplier, inside the notify window, else NOTIFY
9. write the desc ring bus address to Q_DESCLO/Q_DESCHI
10. write the avail ring bus address to Q_AVAILLO/Q_AVAILHI
11. write the used ring bus address to Q_USEDLO/Q_USEDHI
12. avail flags = NO_INTERRUPT
13. write Q_ENABLE = 0x1

## Protocol rules the chip model enforces

- write GF: status must have DRIVER and lack FEATURES_OK
- write Q_SIZE: status must have FEATURES_OK and lack DRIVER_OK
- write Q_ENABLE: status must have FEATURES_OK and lack DRIVER_OK
- write Q_DESCLO: status must have FEATURES_OK and lack DRIVER_OK
- write Q_AVAILLO: status must have FEATURES_OK and lack DRIVER_OK
- write Q_USEDLO: status must have FEATURES_OK and lack DRIVER_OK
- write DOORBELL: status must have DRIVER_OK and lack FAILED

## Evidence

- OASIS virtio v1.2 cs01, 3.1.1 Driver Requirements: Device Initialization: "Re-read device status to ensure the FEATURES_OK bit is still set: otherwise, the device does not support our subset of features and the device is unusable."
- OASIS virtio v1.2 cs01, 2.1.2 Device Requirements: Device Status Field: "MUST reset when 0 is written to device_status, and present a 0 in device_status once that is done. The device MUST present a 0 in queue_enable on reset."
- OASIS virtio v1.2 cs01, 4.1.4.3 Common configuration structure layout: "le32 device_feature_select; /* read-write */ le32 device_feature; /* read-only for driver */ le32 driver_feature_select; /* read-write */ le32 driver_feature; /* read-write */ le16 config_msix_vector; /* read-write */ le16 num_queues; /* read-only for driver */ u8 device_status; /* read-write */ u8 config_generation; /* read-only for driver */"
- OASIS virtio v1.2 cs01, 6.1 Driver Requirements: Reserved Feature Bits: "driver SHOULD accept VIRTIO_F_ACCESS_PLATFORM if it is offered, and it MUST then either disable the IOMMU or configure the IOMMU to translate bus addresses passed to the device into physical addresses"
- OASIS virtio v1.2 cs01, 2.7.8 The Virtqueue Used Ring: "The device MUST set len prior to updating the used idx."
